question: Does a 4% breakout day that falls on a Monday produce better stop-based R than one on Tue-Fri? Indian day-of-week studies report abnormally POSITIVE Monday returns (opposite of the classic US Monday effect), though the effect is reported as weakening in recent years -- expect WEAK/decayed here.
plain: Tests whether Monday is a lucky day for 4%-up-day triggers, per Indian day-of-week studies showing a reversed (positive) Monday effect vs the US.
